gloss: way of calling, how to address

definitions.gloss: way of calling, how to address, what to call something
definitions.explanation: The manner or term used to address or refer to a person or thing. Often used when discussing what name, title, or term is appropriate for someone or something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{呼|よ}び{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わからない。
examples.english: I don't know how to address the teacher.
In Japan, calling people by their surname is the normal way of addressing them.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{呼|よ}び{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{旅行先|りょこうさき}→旅行先：28195_ryokousaki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{戸惑|とまど}う→戸惑う：06036_tomadou⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This fish has different names depending on the region, which can be confusing when traveling.

notes:
USAGE:
{呼|よ}び{方|かた} is formed from ⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧ (to call) + ⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ (way of doing). It is a very common word in everyday conversation, especially when discussing appropriate forms of address or regional naming differences.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {呼|よ}び{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わからない: not know what to call (someone/something)
- {呼|よ}び{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧: have different names for
- ⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧{呼|よ}び{方|かた}: correct way to address
- {呼|よ}び{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧: to change how one addresses (someone)
